title: 第25章 绝境僵持第26章 高台审罚
lines: 脚步声越来越近。
三十多个烬族人踩在暗红色的熔岩地上，脚步又稳又重，每落下一步，都像把凝固的空气压得更紧实。一股股热烘烘的地气混着铁锈和腐烂的臭味，一层层扑过来，把陆寻他们牢牢困在中间。石矛的尖头反射着灰蒙蒙的光，齐齐对准每个人的要害；石斧刃上干涸的血痂，在昏沉沉的天色下透着暗红。没人喊叫，也没人出声吓唬，就靠那一阵阵整齐压过来的脚步声，把这荒原上的窒息感直接拉满。
四周一片死寂，连一丝风都没有，空气好像冻住了。天上那层暗红灰雾正慢慢往下沉，压得人视野越来越窄，把这片百米内的荒原变成了一个逃不出去的笼子。耳朵里嗡嗡作响，盖过了所有细碎声响，只剩下那一下又一下的踏步声，碾得人神经发紧。每一声都沉甸甸的，砸在胸口，闷得发疼。
苏野连肩膀骨头缝里都僵住了。
他手里的刀半出着鞘，刀刃凝着一点寒光。手指死死扣着刀柄，掌心又冷又涩，那股凉意好像渗进了肉里。胳膊上的筋一直绷着，酸得厉害。厮杀的冲动在胸口翻腾，身体早就做好了准备——随时冲出去、格挡、反击。他眼睛死死盯住最前面两个拿矛的烬族人，对方任何一点肌肉抽动、脚步变化，都逃不过他的眼睛——那都可能变成出手的时机。强压下去的杀意在身体里乱撞，每块绷紧的肌肉都像被扯到极限。
铁手盟那十个人，阵型一点没乱。
所有人都屏着呼吸，气只压在胸口最浅的地方。肩膀和后背的肌肉绷得硬邦邦的，脖子上的皮都绷得发白。每个人的眼睛盯着不同方向，把围上来的烬族人看得死死的。他们在西线打惯了，太清楚了：烬族赶人从来不是吓唬，一旦贴近，就是下死手，没有试探、没有商量，只有你死我活。十把短刀横在身前，刀身微微发颤，那股金属的冷气透过掌心，扎得人又硬又紧。
林小满抖得越来越厉害。
混乱的地热，加上烬族人那股暴戾的集体意念，像无数根粗糙的铁针，不停地扎她、扯她、碾她那层薄薄的精神屏障。脑袋深处的刺痛从一阵阵酸胀变成了持续不断的闷疼，太阳穴一跳一跳地发麻，扯得整个头部的神经都绷紧了。远处那灰雾浓得像墨，近处的人影晃来晃去、重重叠叠，看东西一直带着重影。精神感知被压得只剩身边三尺，连对方抬手落脚的小动作，都只能靠眼睛勉强去抓。
她眉头一直死死拧着，眼皮微微发颤，呼吸又浅又急，几乎要断了。胸口起伏小得几乎看不见，全靠拼命控制的呼吸节奏，硬撑着保持清醒。那些原始、嗜血、排外的族群意念，不停地冲刷着她的神经，头皮、脸、脖子一阵阵发麻、发紧、发硬。身体上的难受一层层叠上来，没有半点缓和的余地。
三米。
两米。
烬族人稳步逼近，距离越来越短，贴身厮杀就在眼前。
最前面那几个烬族人手臂微微抬起，石矛的尖儿往下沉了沉，对准了众人下半身的要害。姿势标准又狠，是荒原上无数场厮杀磨出来的致命起手式——没有花招，每一个动作都只为破防、重伤、要命。
值守族长站在人群最前面，那把巨大的熔岩斧斜拖在身边，斧面擦着岩地，磨出细细的石粉。他那只仅剩的左眼又暗又冷，死死盯着陆寻，眼里没有一点情绪，只有纯粹的猎杀判断，就像盯着一群闯进地盘、必死无疑的外来者。脸上狰狞的烧伤疤痕随着他咬牙的动作微微抽动，皮肤绷得紧紧的，底下是积攒了不知多少年的族群恨意。
突然，一切像被按了暂停。
逼近的脚步悬在半空，抬起的武器定住不动，流动的气息彻底断了。整片荒原陷入一片无声无息、死水一样的绝对静止里。只有空气的重量还在暴涨，死死压住每个人的五脏六腑，窒息感一层层叠上来，慢慢吞掉所有人呼吸的空间。
陆寻还站在原地，没退半步，也没动一分。
他背微微松着，没有挺直的姿态，也没有强撑的气势，只有长期透支后那种挥不去的累。眼睛里灰蒙蒙的，没什么神采，视线深处一直发虚。体力的空虚感顺着血脉蔓延到全身，皮肤表面到处是辐射侵蚀后的麻木和钝痛。左腿旧伤那股酸胀的闷疼钻在骨头缝里，每动一下肌肉，都扯出深处的痛感。身体的平衡就踩在要倒不倒的边缘，全凭本能硬撑着稳住。
胸口的十字徽章持续传来一阵阵低沉的灼热感，发麻的范围扩散到整个胸膛。细细密密的烧灼不适感渗进皮肉里，不剧烈，也不尖锐，却顽固又绵长，一点一点啃着他仅剩的体力。同时，徽章又隐隐传来一丝极淡的能量共振，像是在呼应荒原深处某种藏着的、说不清来源的力量——隐隐约约，有点诡异，摸不着头绪。
他五指自然垂着，指节有点僵，手心一片化不开的冰冷涩感。血脉深处残留的地脉紊乱能量还在慢慢窜动，让表面的皮肤一直处于麻木僵硬的状态。他全程没皱眉、没绷紧、脸上没任何变化。所有对峙的压力、厮杀的风险、整队人的安危，全都压在心里，只剩下最底层那种求生的谨慎和冰冷的判断。
“让开。”
值守族长又开口了，声音粗哑干涩，带着火山浊气沉淀后的闷哑，一字一顿，又冷又硬，没有一点商量的余地。
“最后一次。”
陆寻抬起眼，目光穿过层层压过来的杀意，对上对方冰冷的猎杀眼神。声音平直，没有温度，没有起伏，没有倔强，也没有挑衅，只是在说一个事实：
“我不抢地盘。”
“我不夺资源。”
“不复仇，不清算，不树敌。”
三句短话，干脆利落，撕开了漫天紧绷的气氛。每一句都精准地撇清了烬族心里那套固化的敌意认知。没有多余修饰，没有情绪铺垫，只剩下废土上博弈最纯粹的利益陈述。
值守族长左眼里的戾气微微一顿，接着翻涌得更凶。
“外来人，最会讲空话。”
他手腕一翻，那把巨型熔岩斧微微抬起，斧面划过空气，带起一股燥热的风压，裹着浓烈的铁锈腐臭味扑了过来。
“五年前，铁手盟的人来，也是这套说辞。”
“结果呢？聚落被烧，族人被杀，水源被下毒，火种差点就断了。”
“你们的和平，是烬族人的尸山血海。”
content_en:
The footsteps are getting closer.
More than thirty Jhin tribesmen stepped on the dark red lava ground, their steps steady and heavy. Every step they took seemed to press the solidified air tighter. Wave after wave of hot ground air, mixed with the smell of rust and rot, rushed over layer by layer, trapping Lu Xun and the others firmly in the middle. The tips of the stone spears reflected gray light and were aimed at everyone's vital points; the dried blood scabs on the stone ax blades glowed dark red under the gloomy sky. No one shouted or threatened, just the sound of footsteps approaching in unison filled the wilderness with a sense of suffocation.
There was deathly silence all around, not even a breath of wind, and the air seemed frozen. The dark red gray fog in the sky is slowly sinking, making people's vision narrower and narrower, turning the wasteland within a hundred meters into an inescapable cage. There was a buzzing in the ears, covering up all the small sounds, leaving only the sound of footsteps one after another, which made people's nerves tense. Every sound was heavy, hitting my chest, making it painful.
Su Ye froze even to the bones of his shoulders.
The knife in his hand was half out of its sheath, and the blade had a cold light. His fingers were tightly clasped on the handle of the knife, and his palm was cold and astringent, as if the coolness had seeped into his flesh. The tendons in my arms were constantly stretched and sore. The urge to fight surged in his chest, and his body was already prepared—to rush out, block, and counterattack at any time. His eyes were fixed on the first two Jhin tribesmen holding spears. Any muscle twitch or change in their footsteps could not escape his eyes - it might become an opportunity to take action. The suppressed killing intent crashed through his body, and every tense muscle seemed to be stretched to its limit.
The formation of the ten men from the Iron Hand Alliance was not chaotic at all.
Everyone was holding their breath, and the breath was only in the shallowest part of their chests. The muscles on his shoulders and back were stiff and stiff, and the skin on his neck was stretched and white. Everyone's eyes were staring in different directions, staring at the Jhin people who were surrounding them. They are used to fighting on the western front, and they know it very well: the Jhin tribe never drives people away to scare them. Once they get close, they will kill them. There is no temptation, no discussion, just life and death. Ten short knives lay in front of him, the blades trembling slightly, and the cold metal air penetrated the palm of his hand, piercing the person hard and tight.
Lin Xiaoman was shaking more and more violently.
The chaotic geothermal heat, coupled with the violent collective thoughts of the Jhin tribe, were like countless rough iron needles, constantly piercing her, pulling her, and crushing her thin mental barrier. The tingling deep in his head turned from bursts of soreness to a constant dull pain. His temples were numb and numb, and the nerves in his entire head were tense. The gray fog in the distance was as thick as ink, and the figures nearby were swaying and overlapping, making things look like double shadows. His mental perception was reduced to only three feet around him. Even the small movements of the opponent's hands and feet could only be caught with his eyes.
Her brows were furrowed, her eyelids were trembling slightly, and her breathing was shallow and rapid, almost breaking. The rise and fall of his chest was so small that it was almost invisible. He relied on desperately controlling his breathing rhythm to stay awake. Those primitive, bloodthirsty, and xenophobic racial thoughts kept washing over her nerves, causing her scalp, face, and neck to feel numb, tight, and hard. The physical discomfort piled up one after another, leaving no room for relief.
Three meters.
Two meters.
The Jhin people are approaching steadily, the distance is getting shorter and shorter, and a close fight is right in front of them.
The arms of the Jhin tribesmen at the front were raised slightly, and the tips of the stone spears were lowered, aiming at the vital points of their lower bodies. The posture is standard and ruthless, it is a deadly starting move honed in countless battles in the wasteland - there are no tricks, every move is only to break the defense, seriously injure or kill.
The clan leader on duty stood at the front of the crowd, dragging the huge lava ax diagonally beside him. The surface of the ax scraped against the rocky ground, grinding out fine stone powder. His remaining left eye was dark and cold, staring at Lu Xun. There was no emotion in his eyes, only pure hunting judgment, like staring at a group of outsiders who broke into the territory and were bound to die. The hideous burn scars on his face twitched slightly as he gritted his teeth, and the skin was tight. Underneath was the hatred of the clan that had been accumulated for countless years.
Suddenly, everything seemed to be paused.
The approaching footsteps were suspended in mid-air, the raised weapon was frozen, and the flowing breath was completely cut off. The entire wasteland fell into a soundless, absolute stillness like stagnant water. Only the weight of the air is still rising, pressing hard on everyone's internal organs. The feeling of suffocation is rising layer by layer, slowly swallowing up everyone's breathing space.
Lu Xun was still standing where he was, not taking a step back or moving a step.
His back was slightly relaxed, without a straight posture or a strong momentum, only the lingering tiredness after a long period of overdraft. His eyes were gray and dull, and he felt faint in the depths of his vision. The feeling of emptiness in physical strength spreads throughout the body along the blood vessels, and the surface of the skin is covered with numbness and dull pain caused by radiation erosion. The soreness and dull pain from the old injury on his left leg burrowed into the seams of the bones, and every time he moved his muscles, he felt a deep pain. The balance of the body is on the verge of falling over, and it is all based on instinct that holds it steady.
The cross badge on the chest continued to feel a low burning sensation, and the numbness spread to the entire chest. Thin and dense burning discomfort seeped into his skin. It was neither violent nor sharp, but stubborn and long-lasting, biting away at his remaining strength bit by bit. At the same time, there was a faint energy resonance coming from the badge, as if it was echoing some kind of power hidden in the depths of the wasteland with an unknown source - vague, a bit strange, and incomprehensible.
His fingers were hanging naturally, his knuckles were a little stiff, and his palms had a cold and astringent feeling that couldn't be resolved. The chaotic energy of the earth veins remaining deep in the blood vessels is still slowly flowing, leaving the surface skin in a state of numbness and stiffness. He didn't frown, didn't tense up, and didn't have any changes on his face during the whole process. All the pressure of confrontation, the risk of fighting, and the safety of the entire team are all suppressed in the heart, leaving only the lowest level of caution and cold judgment for survival.
"Get out of the way."
The clan leader on duty spoke again, his voice was rough and dry, with the hoarseness caused by the accumulation of volcanic turbidity. Every word was cold and hard, leaving no room for negotiation.
"One last time."
Lu Xun raised his eyes, looking through the layers of murderous intent, and met the other person's cold hunting eyes. The voice is straight, without warmth, without ups and downs, without stubbornness, and without provocation. It just says one fact:
"I don't grab territory."
"I don't take away resources."
"No revenge, no reckoning, no enemies."
Three short sentences, crisp and clear, tore through the tense atmosphere. Each sentence accurately cleared away the solidified hostile perception in the Jhin clan’s heart. There are no superfluous embellishments, no emotional foreshadowing, only the purest statement of interests in the wasteland game.
The anger in the left eye of the clan leader on duty paused for a moment, then surged even more fiercely.
"Outsiders are the best at talking empty words."
He flipped his wrist, and the giant lava ax was slightly raised. The ax surface cut through the air, bringing with it a hot wind pressure and a strong smell of rust and rot.
"Five years ago, when people from the Iron Hand Alliance came, they used the same rhetoric."
"The result? The settlement was burned, the clan members were killed, the water source was poisoned, and the fire was almost cut off."
"Your peace is a mountain of corpses and a sea of blood for the Jhin people."
